title: AnmoFi
tagline: A TeaDapp is a simple crypto tipping platform while drinking tea
description:
A TeaDapp is a simple crypto tipping platform while drinking tea.I have used Metamask wallet for payment ;React+Vite for frontend and solidity for writing the smart contract .For each wallet the payment history log will be shown.TeaDapp is a decentralized application (DApp) built using React + Vite for the frontend, Solidity for smart contracts, and MetaMask for blockchain interactions. The platform allows users to buy, sell, and trade premium tea products securely on the Ethereum blockchain.

Key Features
Decentralized Tea Trading: Users can list and purchase tea products without intermediaries.
Smart Contracts: Secure and transparent transactions are handled via Solidity-based smart contracts.
MetaMask Integration: Users can connect their MetaMask wallets to authenticate and execute transactions.
Blockchain Security: Ensures transparency and immutability of all trade records.
Fast & Responsive UI: Built with React + Vite, ensuring a high-performance and smooth user experience.
Wallet-based Authentication: Users sign in using their Ethereum wallet, eliminating the need for traditional credentials.
Real-time Transaction Updates: Instant updates on purchase confirmations and order history via blockchain events.
